introduction: The English A SBA consists of a Portfolio based on a theme. It includes a Plan of Investigation, three artifacts, reflections, and a group report. It accounts for 21% of the final grade.

tasks.title: Plan of Investigation
tasks.explanation: State the theme, why it was chosen, and how you will investigate it.

tasks.title: Three Artifacts
tasks.explanation: Choose three pieces of material (articles, poems, videos) related to your theme.

tasks.title: Three Reflections
tasks.explanation: Write three reflections on how the artifacts affected your understanding and how they shaped your language skills.

tasks.title: Group Report
tasks.explanation: A summary of the group's research process and findings.

tasks.title: Oral Presentation
tasks.explanation: A short presentation on your theme.

sampleTitle: The impact of social media on the self-esteem of teenagers.

sample.body: Theme: Social Media and Identity. I chose this theme because I have noticed many of my peers feeling pressured by what they see on Instagram. I will investigate this by reading psychological articles, watching documentaries, and analyzing song lyrics about body image.
sample.tips: Ensure you explicitly mention the English language skills you hope to improve.

sample.body: The first artifact I selected was a poem titled 'Digital Masks'. It highlighted the gap between online personas and reality. This piece moved me as it used powerful metaphors to describe the loneliness felt behind a screen.
sample.tips: Focus on both content and language (e.g., tone, vocabulary).

marking: Assessors look for personal engagement with the theme, depth of reflection, and the ability to synthesize information from various sources.
